content:
If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is peaking, reduce forecast by 1.0–1.5% for late horizon (16–30 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is flat, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for early horizon (1–7 days).

If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is below true value, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for mid horizon (8–15 days).

If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is above true value, subtract 0.5–1.0% from forecast for late horizon (16–30 days).
